name: feedback
expr: [num, den] = tfdata(sys, 'v'); r1 = double(sum(den)); r2 = dcgain(feedback(tf(1,[1 1]),1)); r3 = dcgain(feedback(2,tf(1,[1 1])));
comment: Sig: sys = feedback(sys1, sys2[, sign]). Closed-loop feedback. Denominator bit-identical with MATLAB R2025b (1+s+s^2 -> [1 1 1]). 2026-06-03: a NUMERIC arg is a static gain K/1 -- feedback(sys,1) unity feedback (dcgain 0.5), feedback(2,sys) (dcgain 2/3).
